M2 (the start event labelled with the process title) is a naming difference with no supported modeling rule beyond a single title record, and the label-level match P10 and P3 show only wording differences. No new, BPMN-sound guideline is supported by these records, so I abstain.

rules_sent_back.instruction: Use an exclusive merge for alternative paths; it does not wait for inactive alternatives.
rules_sent_back.situation: the description has alternative branches (one branch performs an activity, the other reaches the same point through a different activity) that converge before a common next activity, with no decision made at the convergence

rules_sent_back.instruction: When the description states that after a later check on a whole collection of items fails, the process selects the next item and begins again with an earlier check it has already described: Model a sequence flow from the failing outcome of the later exclusive gateway back to the earlier exclusive gateway that starts the repeated check. If the description states that the next item is selected before the check repeats, model that selection as its own task on the loop-back path, placed before the flow returns to the earlier gateway. Do not end that branch or route it to an unrelated step.

rules_sent_back.instruction: When the description begins with a title line that names the process and gives no other explicit start trigger before its first activity: Label the process's initial start event with the title text from the description, so the start event carries the process name and the first activity follows it.
